correctness.rationale: With y_i=x_i-xbar, A=sum W_i y_i and B=sum W_i y_i^2, the random centered weighted mean is A and the random weighted variance is B-A^2. Uniform Dirichlet monomial moments E(prod W_i^r_i)=prod(r_i!)/(N)_r give EAB=p3/[N(N+1)], EA^3=2p3/[N(N+1)(N+2)] and the required degree-four moments. Subtraction yields Cov(M,V)=N mu3/[(N+1)(N+2)] and Var(V)=N[((N+1)^2 mu4-(N^2-3)mu2^2)]/[(N+1)^2(N+2)(N+3)]. Checked center-translation invariance and the N=2/nonconstant or constant-data boundaries; claimed correlation only with nondegenerate denominators. Independent exact-fraction index-sum checks across 15 datasets N=2..6 support but do not replace general algebra.
